# Routing

- The facade is `MagicRoute`, because Flutter's `Route` is the Navigator class; the doc comments in `facades/route.dart` still say `Route.` in places. `MagicRoute.get` is `@Deprecated`: write `MagicRoute.page`.
- Register routes, layouts and observers before `routerConfig` is first read. That getter builds the GoRouter once, and `addRoute`, `addLayout` and `addObserver` throw a `StateError` afterwards. Only `MagicRouter.reset()` clears the built state, and it also resets `TitleManager`.
- Title updates hang off `routerDelegate.addListener` (`_onRouteChanged`), not a `NavigatorObserver`, so a `go()` or a redirect that never rebuilds the page still updates the route title.
- `TitleManager._applyTitle` sends `primaryColor ?? 0`, never null: Android decodes it with `JSONObject.getInt`, which throws on null and fails every title change with a `PlatformException`.
